risk_title: Compromise of privileged cloud and database accounts
asset: AWS production environment; transaction and customer databases
threat: External attacker using stolen credentials (phishing, malware on an engineer laptop) or a malicious insider
vulnerability: Standing AWS admin rights for five engineers, shared root and database superuser credentials, no privileged access review or monitoring
treatment_plan: Move to SSO-based just-in-time admin roles, lock away root with hardware MFA, replace the shared DB superuser with individual IAM-authenticated roles, alert on privileged activity

risk_title: Customer personal data exposed through the outsourced support vendor
asset: Customer and merchant personal data in the helpdesk and support console
threat: Vendor insider misuse, or compromise of the vendor's environment or shared accounts
vulnerability: No supplier due diligence, no security clauses or DPA, shared logins without MFA, full contact details visible to all agents
treatment_plan: Supplier security assessment, DPA with security schedule and 6-hour breach notification, named MFA-protected accounts, field masking, quarterly access reviews

risk_title: Exploitation of unpatched vulnerabilities in the payment API and merchant dashboard
asset: Payment API; merchant dashboard; underlying containers and libraries
threat: External attacker exploiting known vulnerabilities or OWASP Top 10 weaknesses (e.g. IDOR)
vulnerability: Four High VAPT findings open for nine months, 17 Critical/High dependency alerts, no remediation SLAs, no SAST or container scanning
treatment_plan: Close open High findings within 30 days, set remediation SLAs, add SAST/SCA and container scanning to CI, quarterly ASV scans and retests

risk_title: Undetected intrusion and failure to report within CERT-In's 6-hour window
asset: Payment platform and its security logs
threat: Persistent attacker, ransomware operator or fraud ring operating unnoticed
vulnerability: No security monitoring or alerting, GuardDuty disabled, 30-day log retention, no incident response plan
treatment_plan: Enable GuardDuty and priority alerts, extend log retention to one year, approve and exercise an incident response plan with a regulatory notification matrix, then MDR or SIEM

risk_title: Regulatory penalty for non-compliance with the DPDP Act, 2023
asset: Personal data of customers, merchants and employees
threat: Enforcement by the Data Protection Board after a breach or complaint
vulnerability: No personal data inventory, retention schedule, rights-request process or breach notification procedure; production data used in staging
treatment_plan: DPDP gap assessment, data inventory and flow maps, retention schedule with automated deletion, Data Principal request process, privacy owner appointed

risk_title: Business email compromise leading to fraudulent settlement payouts
asset: Merchant settlement and payout process; finance mailboxes
threat: Social engineering or BEC: an attacker impersonates a merchant or executive to change bank details or approve a payout
vulnerability: Induction-only awareness training, no phishing simulation, payout bank-detail changes accepted by email with a single approver
treatment_plan: Buy cyber insurance with social-engineering fraud cover to transfer residual financial loss; supporting controls: dual approval and call-back verification for bank-detail changes, role-based BEC training

risk_title: Exposure of production personal data in non-production environments
threat: Accidental leakage or attacker access to the less-protected staging environment
vulnerability: Production database copied to staging without masking; staging has broader access and weaker monitoring
treatment_plan: Stop copying production data to non-production; use synthetic or irreversibly masked datasets generated by a controlled pipeline; purge existing staging copies

risk_title: Prolonged outage of the AWS Mumbai region disrupting payment processing
threat: Cloud provider regional outage or large-scale service disruption
vulnerability: Single-region, multi-AZ deployment; no tested regional failover (backups are copied to Hyderabad)
treatment_plan: Accept within appetite: Multi-AZ resilience and cross-region backups are in place and active-active multi-region costs are disproportionate at current scale. Document a DR runbook, re-evaluate at 12 months or when monthly volume exceeds 3 million transactions
